coverage.text: This Addendum is issued under Volume I Clause 5.3 and takes precedence over Addendum No. 1 in accordance with Volume I Clause 3.2.
In Volume I Clause 9.2, ‘one hundred and twenty (120) pages’ is deleted and ‘one hundred and fifty (150) pages’ is substituted.
Table 1-1 of Volume I is deleted and replaced by the table below. The marks available for criterion D are increased and those for criterion B reduced correspond
Ref: A | Criterion: Process design, treatment performance and compliance with Volume II | Marks: 25
Ref: B | Criterion: Construction methodology, programme and interface management | Marks: 15
Ref: C | Criterion: Operations and maintenance philosophy and lifecycle strategy | Marks: 20
Ref: D | Criterion: Environmental and social management | Marks: 20
Ref: E | Criterion: Organisation, key personnel and consortium governance | Marks: 10
Ref: F | Criterion: Health, safety and security of supply | Marks: 10
Criterion: Total | Marks: 100

coverage.reason: introduces the notes to the revised table; each note has its own entry
coverage.text: Notes to Table 1-1 (revised):
(1)  The technical score threshold in Volume I Clause 11.3 is unchanged at seventy (70) marks.
(2)  The combined score weighting stated in Volume I Clause 11.2 is amended to sixty-five per cent (65%) technical and thirty-five per cent (35%) commercial.
(3)  Marks are awarded on the Authority's standard five-point scale and multiplied by the weight shown.
In Volume II Clause 4.4, ‘seventy-two (72) hours’ is deleted and ‘ninety-six (96) hours’ is substituted.
In Volume II Table 2-4, the limit for Total Nitrogen (TN) is amended from the value shown to 3 mg/l, assessed on the same basis. All other parameters in Table 2
Bidders shall reflect the amended limit in the process design submitted under Volume II Section 3.
No: 7 | Bidder question: Volume I Clause 12.1 states the concession runs from PCOD. Volume V Clause 3.1 states it runs from the Effective Date. Which applies? |
No: 8 | Bidder question: Is the Bid Bond amount a percentage of the bid price? | Authority response: No. The amount is fixed and stated in Volume I Clause 6.4.
No: 9 | Bidder question: May Form 4-C be submitted in English with an Arabic translation? | Authority response: No. Form 4-C shall be completed in Arabic. An En
No: 10 | Bidder question: Is a parent company guarantee also required from the O&M Operator? | Authority response: No. Volume I Clause 8.7 requires a Parent Com
No: 11 | Bidder question: Table 2-6 shows a peak hourly flow of 7,500 m³/h against a daily average of 120,000 m³/day. Please confirm. | Authority response: Bidd
No: 12 | Bidder question: Are the deductions under Volume V Clause 31 capped? | Authority response: The Authority refers Bidders to the wording of Clause 31.2.
No: 13 | Bidder question: Will the Authority extend the Financial Close long-stop date? | Authority response: The periods in Volume I Clause 12.2 are unchanged.
No: 14 | Bidder question: May an alternative technical solution be submitted alone? | Authority response: No. Volume I Clause 10.5 applies.
A new Form 4-G is added to Volume IV and to the list at Volume I Clause 9.1, to be inserted after item (e).
Form 4-G shall be completed and submitted with Envelope A. Failure to submit Form 4-G shall render the Proposal non-responsive.

Item: 6 | Undertaking: Remote access to the control system will require multi-factor authentication and will be logged. | Confirmed: Yes / No
